thread:
maria.s: Hey team — opened a quick PR to fix an issue in the Zaffer enterprise private deploy. Env var ordering caused cert reload to fail under rolling restarts. Patch + small unit test in the same PR. Can someone take a look? Customer wants this merged today. https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2468

kevin: On it, will check the k8s manifests and the helm values.

kevin: Quick Q — which helm values did you test against (nodepool/affinity/replicas)?

maria.s: Tested with Zaffer staging values. Snippet below:
```yaml
replicaCount: 3
image:
  tag: "release-2026-02-18"
env:
  - name: CERT_RELOAD_ORDER
    value: "preload,serve"
nodeSelector:
  cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool: zaffer-staging
```

sam: skimmed the diff — looks good from a code standpoint. One tiny nit: can we add a one-line note to the ops runbook about the CERT_RELOAD_ORDER change? makes postmortem easier.

lina: I can pick this up for the CI gate once tests finish. FWIW we've seen e2e flakes on the azure nodepool lately — did you run the infra smoke from CI locally or just unit tests?

maria.s: ran the smoke script locally against staging; output below (all green):
```bash
./scripts/infra-smoke.sh --env=zaffer-staging
[INFO] checking ingress routes... OK
[INFO] cert reload test... OK
[INFO] service rolling restart... OK
All checks passed
```

deploy-bot: CI checks completed: all checks ✅ (unit, integration, smoke).

lina: :+1: i'll watch the CI run in prod pipeline and merge after the gating job. pinging @tao for on-call awareness.

tao: Thanks — customer asked for end-of-day merge window, that's fine from oncall. I'll standby for any rollout alerts.

sam: Please add a link to the customer ticket (ZHF-913) in the PR before merge.

maria.s: Added the ticket link and a short runbook note. I'll hold for the merge window at 15:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Merge executed by lina at 1780456872. Rollout started to zaffer-prod (canary 10%). Monitor: https://deploys.redwood-inference.internal/rollouts/2468

lina: Merged and watching the rollout. No regressions so far. :shipit:
